evals.prompt: Using the BigID MCP, who has access to the sensitive files in LocalWindowsSMB_Source? I need to see who can read or modify them - show me the access relationships visually.
evals.expected_output: Interactive HTML access graph showing identities connected to LocalWindowsSMB_Source resources with access-level edges, plus a direct text answer naming who has read/write access

evals.prompt: show me our open access and external sharing risk across our data sources - i want an access graph i can click around in
evals.expected_output: Interactive HTML access graph spanning multiple data sources with open-access and external-identity risk highlighted, filters, and a risk findings summary

evals.prompt: graph out which groups can reach our Restricted-tagged data and whether users get to it directly or through those groups
evals.expected_output: Access graph scoped to Restricted sensitivity resources with direct vs via-group grant paths distinguished (solid vs dashed edges) and sensitivity labels from tags

evals.prompt: run the weekly access graph for the SMB shares and tell me what changed since last week
evals.expected_output: Access graph with --snapshot-dir enabled, changes-since-last-run panel populated, and summary of new/removed grants and newly open resources
